dct_title_s: Tonga Hunga Tonga Volcano: Damage Proxy Maps, Jan 2022
dct_description_sm: # Tonga Hunga Tonga Volcano: Damage Proxy Maps, Jan 2022 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Tonga Hunga Tonga Volcano (Jan 2022) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Tonga, Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai volcano, 27 Jan 2022, v0.5 wbd** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Tonga, Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai volcano, 22 Jan 2022, v0.5 wbd** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Tonga, Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai volcano, 15 Jan 2022, v0.9 wbd** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Tonga, Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha'apai volcano, 15 Jan 2022, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:**
